Towers are built on the grid around your Base. Most of them need **power**: build generators and batteries
in reach, or feed a tower yourself (hold **F** while looking at it). Upgrading the Base raises the level cap for
every other tower.

## Defense

| Tower | Main crystal | Build cost |
|---|---|---|
| [Shield Wall](/wiki/towers/shield-wall/) | Obsidian | 25 Obsidian |
| [Spike Wall](/wiki/towers/spike-wall/) | Obsidian | 45 Obsidian |
| [Stone Wall](/wiki/towers/stone-wall/) | Obsidian | 15 Obsidian |
| [Stone Door](/wiki/towers/stone-door/) | Obsidian | 25 Obsidian |
| [Rime Vent](/wiki/towers/rime-vent/) | Obsidian | 10 Amber, 30 Obsidian |
